attributes.size: larger at 573K than at ambient temperature

evidence.quote: On CuCrZr/SS316LN-IG and CuCrZr/SS316LN HIPed joints, dimples were formed closely at ambient temperature, whereas at 573K, formed sparsely and larger sizes than those at ambient temperature.
the characteristic shape of 'stretched zone' shown in Figo was confirmed on CuCrZr/SS316LN-IG at ambient and CuCrZr/SS316L at ambient temperature and 573K.

attributes.location: CuCrZr side next to the HIPed joint interface

evidence.quote: It has been observed that the intermediate layer of especially Zr rich was formed next to the HIPed joint interface in CuCrZr side. It was considered that the layer that is weaker against crack propagation than HIPed interface was formed and that the crack was propagated in that layer.
The lost of ductility of all materials caused the decrement of fracture toughness and increment of crack propagation ratio in high temperature (573K).

unresolved_terms: CuCrZr/SS316LN-IG fracture toughness JIC values (249*, 35) with invalid reference marks

conflicts.description: Non-heat-treated CuCrZr JIC at 573K (704 kJ/m2) is higher than at ambient (450 kJ/m2), contrary to the general trend of decreasing toughness with increasing temperature; authors attribute this to test invalidity and high ductility.

evidence.quote: As to non-heat treated CuCrZr base metals, JIG value at 573K was higher than that at ambient temperature.
